change: Added Abductor->Abductor and Adductors->Adductors to secondary. The jumping jack leg motion clearly drives hip abduction (abductors pulling legs out) and adduction (adductors pulling legs back together); these were missing from the original data. Also removed Quads (Rectus Femoris) from secondary — quad contribution is incidental and not meaningfully distinct in an isometric forearm plank with a jump; the abductor/adductor engagement is more significant for this movement pattern.
No changes. Primary abs + Rectus Femoris (as hip flexor) and secondary obliques, anterior deltoids, glutes confirmed correct by research.

Moved glutes (Gluteus Maximus) from secondary to primary — glutes are a prime mover in the lunge step (hip extension/drive). Added Hamstrings (Biceps Femoris, Semitendinosus) to secondary per the mandatory lunge/squat rule (hamstrings secondary on all lunges). Also removed the Quads-only secondary for Hamstrings was missing.
No changes. Primary abs and secondary obliques, Erector Spinae, anterior deltoids, Gluteus Maximus all confirmed correct by EMG research on forearm planks.

No changes. Primary obliques and secondary abs, shoulders (anterior + lateral for stabilizing/reaching arm), Rotator Cuff, Gluteus Medius (side plank hip support) all confirmed correct for this side plank thread-the-needle rotation exercise.
